tools.name: vault_exists

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: Free. Reports the remaining balance on a credit token so you can tell 'out of credit' apart from 'the call failed', which otherwise look identical from the outside. This tool is free; no payment is required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: meetings_search, meetings_summarize, meetings_import, meetings_get, meetings_list, scrape, reach · Private data: meetings_search, x402_verify, meetings_summarize, meetings_import, meetings_get, meetings_list, once_key_claim, once_key_complete, vault_store, vault_retrieve, vault_exists, vault_delete, vault_list, vault_rotate_token, pdf_parse, scrape, reach, reach_report, compress, credits_trial, credits_balance · Public sink: meetings_import, once_key_claim, reach, credits_trial · Destructive: once_key_release, vault_delete, vault_rotate_token, credits_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: meetings_search, meetings_summarize, meetings_import, meetings_get, meetings_list, scrape, reach · Private data: meetings_search, x402_verify, meetings_summarize, meetings_import, meetings_get, meetings_list, once_key_claim, once_key_complete, vault_store, vault_retrieve, vault_exists, vault_delete, vault_list, vault_rotate_token, pdf_parse, scrape, reach, reach_report, compress, credits_trial, credits_balance · Public sink: meetings_import, once_key_claim, reach, credits_trial · Destructive: once_key_release, vault_delete, vault_rotate_token, credits_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
